guard/31299.htm.text: Guard Eugen: Welcome, stranger! Our kingdom traces its ancestry directly to the ancient Elmoreden empire! Relics of the empire have been discovered in many parts of our kingdom. Many of our ancient emperors rest nearby in the Imperial Tomb . It makes that tower look like a decrepit stump!

links.text: "Who is the lord of the manor and what is the tax rate?"

guard/31299-1.htm.text: Guard Eugen: I've never been there myself, but I've heard that it's a huge underground catacomb north of Argos Wall.
